'''Gan Corla''' was a [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Master armorer]] living in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] around [[25,793 BBY]]. He helped the [[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Lanoree Brock]] upgrade and customize the cannons on her ship.
